title: The Sklyanin determinant of the complex reflection algebra B(n,l), for n at least two and zero at most l at most n, has the explicit ordered matrix-entry formula indexed by increasing tuples and image-supported permutations
author: Natasha Rozhkovskaya
difficulty_reason: A noncommutative reflection determinant cannot be expanded by the ordinary permutation rule because its shifted generating matrices are interleaved with R-matrices. The author reduces the antisymmetrized R-products to Jucys-Murphy sums, constructs a bijection reorganizing their transposition indices, and tracks the ordered matrix entries through repeated-image cycles. The surviving image-supported permutations and rational weights then give the explicit formula without commuting the algebra coefficients.
